# World words and twinkling stars while you move fast or travel, fix/move123 (1280x720, 1.21.11, the demo song).
# `cmd` runs as the server, not the player, so anything placed at the player goes through `execute at @p`. Boats are
# minecraft:oak_boat since 1.21.2 (minecraft:boat on 1.21.1). Each shot, the branch against main:
# 1. A long fall with Elytra mode off (survival, Resistance V so the landing doesn't hurt): move123-fall_00..09 are taken
#    while you fall past 30 blocks a second from y 320. On main the words sung during the fall come down with you and
#    stay round you in every frame, as if Elytra mode were on; on the branch each new word is left where it was put and
#    shoots up out of the view within a few frames (most frames show only the newest word or none).
#    move123-landed: on the ground again, the same on both (new words round you).
# 2. Riding a boat (Elytra mode on, it counts as riding), with more and bigger words so some slide apart: before the
#    turn (move123-boat-before) and right after a quarter turn to the west (move123-boat-turn_00..05, move123-boat-after).
#    On the branch the words keep their places beside each other through the turn (the same arrangement, turned with
#    you). On main a word that had slid aside out of another's way is put off its spot by the turn, onto or next to the
#    word it moved away from, and glides apart again in the burst frames. Only words that had slid show it: compare
#    pairs of words in move123-boat-before with move123-boat-after.
# 3. Twinkling stars with World Direction N, still riding, looking east (move123-stars-riding-east): on the branch the
#    stars twinkle round the words in front of you; on main the words are there but the stars stay in the north, out of
#    this view. After getting off the boat (move123-stars-standing-east): the stars have gone back north on both, so
#    none are round the words that came while riding; the words of the next lines go north on both.
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=main to compare with the old code (the script comes from --ref):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/move123 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/move123.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/move123 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/move123.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set layout WORLD
look 0 -10
sleep 8

# 1. Elytra mode off, a long fall
set worldGlide false
cmd gamemode survival @p
cmd effect give @p minecraft:resistance 60 4 true
cmd execute as @p at @s run tp @s ~ 320 ~ 0 -10
sleep 1.5
burst move123-fall 10 300
sleep 7
shot move123-landed
cmd gamemode creative @p
set worldGlide true

# 2. Riding a boat, a quarter turn
set worldWords 14
set size 1.6
cmd execute at @p run summon minecraft:oak_boat ~ ~ ~
sleep 1
cmd ride @p mount @e[type=minecraft:oak_boat,limit=1,sort=nearest]
look 0 -10
sleep 10
shot move123-boat-before
look 90 -10
burst move123-boat-turn 6 150
sleep 2
shot move123-boat-after

# 3. Twinkling stars with Direction N while riding, then standing
set worldWords 7
set size 1
set twinkle true
set direction NORTH
look -90 -20
sleep 6
shot move123-stars-riding-east
cmd ride @p dismount
sleep 5
shot move123-stars-standing-east

# Leave it as it was
cmd kill @e[type=minecraft:oak_boat]
set direction FOLLOW
set twinkle false
look 0 -10
